faq.q: Do you sail in bad weather?
faq.a: - Sail Door County encourages guests to book early during your Door County vacation! This gives you time to reschedule in the chance that we have to cancel due to inclement weather. Sail Door county monitors the weather at all times and we do not sail in adverse conditions. Should the weather be unfavorable, we will cancel.
